svg.text: I added Redis redirect caching with invalidation, reduced database and
serialization overhead, and tuned Gunicorn and Nginx. In the merged PR’s
development benchmark, GET /urls handled 76.6% more requests per second with
43.4% lower latency. All 174 existing tests passed.
For updates, I limited database writes to the fields that changed. For list
endpoints, I returned dictionaries directly to avoid constructing model
objects for every row. Redirects use Redis with invalidation when a URL
changes or is deleted. I also adjusted PostgreSQL WAL settings, Nginx response
